highlights: Magnificent Padmapani and Vajrapani bodhisattva murals on either side of the shrine antechamber. Elaborate pillared verandah with painted ceilings depicting Jataka tales. Contains a seated Buddha in preaching posture in the sanctum.
visit_info: Must-see (Top 5). Estimated time: 45 minutes. Open 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM (Closed Mondays). ASI Entry: Rs 40 (cash) / Rs 35 (online), children under 15 years FREE.

highlights: Renowned for well-preserved wall paintings showing palace scenes, royal processions, and the birth of Buddha. Carved pillars with ornate capitals. Central shrine with seated Buddha flanked by bodhisattvas and celestial beings.
visit_info: Must-see (Top 5). Estimated time: 40 minutes. Open 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM (Closed Mondays). ASI Entry: Rs 40 (cash) / Rs 35 (online), children under 15 years FREE.

highlights: One of the earliest chaitya halls with a horseshoe-shaped entrance. Features a monolithic stupa at the center with wooden ribs on the vaulted ceiling. Simple octagonal pillars lean inward creating a sacred ambulatory path.
visit_info: Estimated time: 25 minutes. Open 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM (Closed Mondays). ASI Entry: Rs 40 (cash) / Rs 35 (online), children under 15 years FREE.

highlights: The oldest surviving cave at Ajanta. Chaitya hall with apsidal end and a monolithic stupa. Contains the earliest Brahmi inscriptions mentioning donations by merchants and monks. Wooden beam fragments still visible in vault.
visit_info: Estimated time: 30 minutes. Open 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM (Closed Mondays). ASI Entry: Rs 40 (cash) / Rs 35 (online), children under 15 years FREE.

highlights: Famous for the 'Dying Princess' (Sundari) mural showing a queen in grief upon hearing of Buddha's impending nirvana. Large vihara with exquisite paintings of the Conversion of Nanda and multiple Jataka tales.
visit_info: Must-see (Top 5). Estimated time: 50 minutes. Open 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM (Closed Mondays). ASI Entry: Rs 40 (cash) / Rs 35 (online), children under 15 years FREE.

highlights: Exceptional preservation of paintings showing Buddha's life events, Jataka tales including Vessantara, and elaborate decorative patterns. Painted ceiling with floral and geometric motifs. Verandah columns with scroll work.
visit_info: Must-see (Top 5). Estimated time: 45 minutes. Open 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM (Closed Mondays). ASI Entry: Rs 40 (cash) / Rs 35 (online), children under 15 years FREE.

highlights: Elaborate chaitya hall with intricately carved facade featuring Buddha figures, celestial beings, and mythical creatures. Richly decorated stupa with umbrella capital. Pillared interior with horse-shoe window for natural lighting.
visit_info: Estimated time: 35 minutes. Open 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM (Closed Mondays). ASI Entry: Rs 40 (cash) / Rs 35 (online), children under 15 years FREE.

highlights: Grand chaitya hall featuring the majestic reclining Buddha in Mahaparinirvana (final nirvana) pose carved on the left wall, nearly 7 meters long. Intricately carved pillars and a large sculptured stupa with seated Buddha.
visit_info: Must-see (Top 5). Estimated time: 40 minutes. Open 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM (Closed Mondays). ASI Entry: Rs 40 (cash) / Rs 35 (online), children under 15 years FREE.

highlights: Largest Buddhist vihara at Ellora with a rectangular hall supported by 24 pillars. Features two parallel rows of stone benches that may have served as dining hall or assembly area for monks. Simple yet spacious monastic architecture.
visit_info: Estimated time: 20 minutes. Open Sunrise to Sunset (Closed Tuesdays). ASI Entry: Rs 40 (cash) / Rs 35 (online), children under 15 years FREE.

highlights: Known as 'Vishwakarma' or Carpenter's Cave due to its wooden-like carved interior. Chaitya hall with ribbed vault ceiling resembling wooden beams. Features a large seated Buddha in teaching posture carved from the stupa itself.
visit_info: Must-see (Top 5). Estimated time: 35 minutes. Open Sunrise to Sunset (Closed Tuesdays). ASI Entry: Rs 40 (cash) / Rs 35 (online), children under 15 years FREE.

highlights: Three-storied vihara known as 'Tin Thal' with large Buddha sculptures in preaching posture. Contains shrines on each floor with elaborate carvings of bodhisattvas, guardian deities, and celestial attendants. Demonstrates advanced rock-cutting techniques.
visit_info: Estimated time: 40 minutes. Open Sunrise to Sunset (Closed Tuesdays). ASI Entry: Rs 40 (cash) / Rs 35 (online), children under 15 years FREE.

highlights: Transitional cave showing both Buddhist and Hindu elements. Ground floor contains Buddhist sculptures while upper floor features Hindu deities including Durga, Lakshmi, and the Seven Mothers (Saptamatrikas). Marks the shift from Buddhist to Hindu patronage.
visit_info: Estimated time: 30 minutes. Open Sunrise to Sunset (Closed Tuesdays). ASI Entry: Rs 40 (cash) / Rs 35 (online), children under 15 years FREE.

highlights: Two-storied cave known as 'Dashavatara' (Ten Incarnations of Vishnu) with elaborate panels depicting Vishnu's avatars. Features Shiva emerging from linga, Shiva-Parvati marriage scene, and Ravana shaking Mount Kailasa. Connects courtyard to upper gallery.
visit_info: Must-see (Top 5). Estimated time: 45 minutes. Open Sunrise to Sunset (Closed Tuesdays). ASI Entry: Rs 40 (cash) / Rs 35 (online), children under 15 years FREE.

highlights: The world-famous monolithic Kailasa Temple, carved from a single rock representing Mount Kailasa. Dedicated to Lord Shiva, featuring colossal elephants, intricate panels of Ramayana and Mahabharata, and the Ravana lifting Mount Kailasa sculpture. Approximately 200,000 tons of rock excavated.
visit_info: Must-see (Top 5). Estimated time: 90-120 minutes. Open Sunrise to Sunset (Closed Tuesdays). ASI Entry: Rs 40 (cash) / Rs 35 (online), children under 15 years FREE.

highlights: Known as 'Rameshvara' cave with exquisite sculptures of river goddesses Ganga and Yamuna at entrance. Features beautiful carvings of dancing Shiva, goddess Parvati, and various attendant figures. Notable for its refined sculptural quality.
visit_info: Estimated time: 25 minutes. Open Sunrise to Sunset (Closed Tuesdays). ASI Entry: Rs 40 (cash) / Rs 35 (online), children under 15 years FREE.

highlights: Known as 'Dhumar Lena' with impressive Shiva-Parvati sculptures and a magnificent panel showing Ravana shaking Mount Kailasa while Shiva remains calm. Features courtyard design similar to Kailasa Temple. Contains carvings of Nandi bull and Shiva Linga.
visit_info: Estimated time: 35 minutes. Open Sunrise to Sunset (Closed Tuesdays). ASI Entry: Rs 40 (cash) / Rs 35 (online), children under 15 years FREE.

highlights: Small Jain cave known as 'Chhota Kailasa' (Little Kailasa) modeled after Cave 16. Features a shrine with seated Jain Tirthankara and a monolithic Manastambha (pillar). Demonstrates Jain architectural adaptation of Hindu temple style.
visit_info: Estimated time: 20 minutes. Open Sunrise to Sunset (Closed Tuesdays). ASI Entry: Rs 40 (cash) / Rs 35 (online), children under 15 years FREE.

highlights: Known as 'Indra Sabha' (Assembly Hall of Indra), the finest Jain cave at Ellora. Two-storied structure with ornately carved pillars, lotus ceiling, and seated Mahavira sculpture. Upper floor shrine contains Tirthankara Mahavira with attendant yakshas and yakshinis.
visit_info: Must-see (Top 5). Estimated time: 45 minutes. Open Sunrise to Sunset (Closed Tuesdays). ASI Entry: Rs 40 (cash) / Rs 35 (online), children under 15 years FREE.

highlights: Known as 'Jagannatha Sabha' with a simple pillared hall leading to a shrine. Contains seated Tirthankara figures with characteristic Jain iconography including umbrella (chhatra) and fly-whisk bearers. Features carved elephants and lions at entrance.
visit_info: Estimated time: 25 minutes. Open Sunrise to Sunset (Closed Tuesdays). ASI Entry: Rs 40 (cash) / Rs 35 (online), children under 15 years FREE.

highlights: Final cave at Ellora, a small shrine dedicated to Jain Tirthankaras. Contains sanctum with standing and seated Tirthankara images showing refined late-period Jain sculptural style. Represents the culmination of Ellora's rock-cut tradition spanning three religions.
visit_info: Estimated time: 15 minutes. Open Sunrise to Sunset (Closed Tuesdays). ASI Entry: Rs 40 (cash) / Rs 35 (online), children under 15 years FREE.
